segments.normalizedSource: ```swift struct GestureExample: View { @State private var message = "Message" let newGesture = TapGesture().onEnded { print("Tap on VStack.") } var body: some View { VStack(spacing:25) { Image(systemName: "heart.fill") .resizable() .frame(width: 75, height: 75) .padding() .foregroundColor(.red) .onTapGesture { print("Tap on image.") } Rectangle() .fill(Color.blue) } .gesture(newGesture) .frame(width: 200, height: 200) .border(Color.purple) } } ```
